## Blood Spear

![](../../assets/playable/inofruits/abilities/blood_spear.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

Throws a spear of the user's hardened blood that makes the target bleed. Costs blood.

The health-based part of the direct hit accounts for size before pack and Doriki modifiers. The short recovery applies when there is too little blood to cast.

<div class="entry-stats" markdown="1">

| Stat | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Cooldown | 3 s (60 ticks) |
| Failed cast recovery | 0.5 s (10 ticks) |
| Blood cost | 2 |
| Direct hit at standard size | 6 HP + 3% of maximum HP |
| Pack multiplier when dealing damage | 2.9× |

</div>
